beats.what: close on the front wheel wobbling; her foot goes down to catch the balance
wide quiet square; she looks at the pedal, pushes off, rolls a little, stops (second try)
her grown son walks in, steadies the saddle; they exchange a look; her feet find both pedals
the bike rolls; his hand eases off the saddle and stays behind; she rides on alone, the camera with her
she brakes gently, looks back along the distance, finds him, smiles with quiet pride
a simple composition, her and the bike small; the question on blank paper

lines: حتى لو لم يصفّق له أحد؟
question.text: «ما الإنجاز الذي تفخرين به أكثر في حياتكِ، حتى لو لم يصفّق له أحد؟»
